title: Unit Event — Stick to Your Faith — Episode7 Stick To Your Faith

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need are gearing up to make their professional debut. As their label considers how best to market the band, Mr. Shindo asks the girls what music they aspire to.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (I can feel it resonating deep in my gut...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (All these jolts are going up and down my body, and it's making my heart dance. I feel like shouting at the top of my lungs...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (I've seen a lot of people perform, but I've never seen anyone put on this kind of show...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
(Huh? Sumire...?
Did she look my way just now...?)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
(Their sound's resonating with my heart...
I'm having so much fun that it won't stop racing...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
(And this band is the reason why.
They're moving everyone's hearts through music alone...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (How else do I put it...? This is...)

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: People who do what they love and put everything they have into making their dreams come true have this dazzling aura.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (Sumire never let go of what she loved most and kept honing her craft.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (That's why her band's able to put on this kind of performance for everyone. That's why I'm feeling all this excitement.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (No, it's not just that. People who do what they love, they really...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: How do I put it...? Their sound... I felt it with my whole body...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I guess it was worth the trip.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Are you done packing up already?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Hehe... I really wanted to talk to Shiho again before we left, so I kinda asked the others to take care of things for a minute.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: I need to get back before long... Anyway, Shiho, what did you think?! Did you like our show?!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
I-It was really amazing...
You were so cool during the whole thing...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I got so excited during your show that I didn't want it to ever end.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank goodness!
I'm glad you enjoyed it so much.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I wanna be just like you...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I wanna do what you said, Sumire, and do what I love...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
Your performance today...
It told me it's okay for me to do that.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: I think I played better than usual because I did my best to reach you with my performance today, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: I know! Shiho, how would you feel about learning to play the bass more?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: I won't force you to or anything, but you just seemed to have so much fun during our little session earlier...!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I do wanna learn to play it better...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
You do! Fantastic!
I'm so glad you're saying that.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
I promise to practice a lot.
And someday...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I'm gonna learn to put on shows like the one you just did, Sumire...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Hehe. She's definitely your daughter, Mr. Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: But I'm not letting you hog all the glory...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: By the time you've become better, Shiho, I'll be miles and miles up ahead.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: But I hope you'll keep chasing after me.

rows.Speaker: Iolite Member A
rows.Line: Sumire, come back and help us pack already.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
Gotta go.
Thank you both again for coming to see our show today, Shiho, Mr. Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm probably never ever going to forget it.)
